scope: Original KeyNumber open/close/update state and SceneTreeTween sequence, including count bounces queued before the tween starts and killed close yields. A count update during an already started bounce has a reviewed native append failure and null-from script error; these are explicit diagnostics, not a successfully queued animation. Region/counter identity is the separately reviewed dungeon key policy. No complete UI scene, fonts, icon rendering, full dungeon, persistent counter/save or generic tween VM is admitted.

engine.scope: Source float32 property duration, elapsed time, incoming delta and remainder order; start also occurs at zero delta. Original unconfigured SceneTreeTween defaults to LINEAR/IN_OUT, while the KeyNumber update-created tween sets SINE/OUT. Bounded HUD sequence only, not an engine or tween VM port.
